visual_style: Vertical 9:16, crisp warm daylight, energetic realistic cinematic look with named camera moves. Pakistani settings: government schools with whitewashed walls, plain green blackboards with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame; papers and screens are blurred and unreadable. Recipe v2: in shots 1 and 5 the on-screen presenter speaks to the camera; in shots 2-4 an unseen narrator speaks as a voice-over and nobody on screen speaks.

narrator.name: presenter and voice-over
narrator.description: On screen in shots 1 and 5: a confident Pakistani male teacher in his forties in a navy shalwar kameez and a grey waistcoat, speaking Urdu to the camera with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery. Shots 2-4: an unseen Pakistani woman narrator, lively and quick, voice-over only.

shots.visual: In a school staff room, a confident Pakistani male teacher in his forties in a navy shalwar kameez and a grey waistcoat lowers a newspaper, raises an eyebrow, then turns to the camera; quick push-in to a close-up.
Handheld orbit around a classroom where pupils survey each other with clipboards and mark tallies on a large chart.
Energetic tracking shot across a schoolyard: pupils measure each other's heights against a wall, then a whip-pan to a group rolling dice at a table.
Rising crane shot over a computer lab where teachers work at laptops and one points excitedly at a chart on her screen.

In a sunlit school corridor, a confident Pakistani male teacher in his forties in a navy shalwar kameez and a grey waistcoat walks briskly toward the camera, holds up a phone with a blurred screen and smiles; fast push-in to a close-up as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: خبروں میں ہر روز اعداد و شمار، مگر کون سا number سچ بتا رہا ہے؟
اس کورس میں آپ data کو ترتیب دینا، tables اور graphs بنانا اور پڑھنا سیکھیں گے۔
sampling، mean اور variation، probability اور relationships، سب روزمرہ مثالوں سے۔
سولہ units، estimation اور hypothesis testing تک، تاکہ آپ شواہد کی بنیاد پر فیصلے کریں۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔
